content:
alex: Quick sync — need to finalize Q2 roadmap slice for private deployments. Focus: customer-managed networking, upgrade lanes that preserve tenant IPs, and operator-first packaging. I want to align launch criteria this week.

megan: +1. Can we list the minimal launch criteria? uptime SLA differences (Dedicated vs Private), supported topology matrix, and rollback windows. :clipboard:

sam: Also need a clear migration path for static-peering customers. How do we guarantee IP preservation during in-place upgrades?

irene: From last field test: operator flow = preflight -> staged rollout -> metadata sync -> live cutoff. Preconditions: config version pinning + customerctl v0.9. That avoided IP flips for 3/3 customers we tried.

alex: Proposed launch criteria (draft): 1) Installer supports offline bootstrap (airgap) 2) Upgrade can be run without IP reassign 3) Handshake API for netops (customer-managed) 4) Canary window + auto-fallback 5) Rollback playbook validated in staging.

julian: For auto-fallback we should implement a "fallthrough proxy" pattern — if new net config fails, traffic routes to previous control-plane. Ops impact?

sam: Ops impact: extra NAT rules and a short-lived gateway. We'll need a tiny helper to compute and apply ACL diffs automatically. Also add a dry-run mode.

irene: helper usage example: ```customerctl network-diff --from v1.2 --to v1.3 --tenant tenant-123``` -> prints ACL delta + suggested commands.

megan: Risk measurement idea: add a migration risk score (0-10) per release and require manual approval for >7. Also require customer signoff for >5.

alex: Agree. Action items: 1) land checklist, 2) score rubric, 3) owner assignments, 4) pilot with 5 low-risk tenants.

julian: Note: several private infra customers require KMS/HSM integration during upgrade — legal/finance will block without it. Mark as dependency.

deploy-bot: [deployment] staged rollout started for private-upgrade-lane v0.3.4 -> canary group: 12 tenants. Logs: https://deploy/redwood/upgrade/v0.3.4

sam: Good. Assign owners: alex (PM), megan (launch lead), irene (operator UX), julian (customer telemetry).

megan: I'll draft the launch criteria doc by EOD Friday and include checklist: preflight tests, ACL diff, customer signoff, rollback playbook, SLA workbook. @alex any extra asks?

alex: Last open item: bundling strategy. Ops prefers a thin bundle + customer-managed network agent; Product prefers single all-in-one installer for easier support. We'll take a quick vote in the sync and decide. :ballot_box_with_check:

julian: I'll surface customer telemetry before the sync (who wants thin bundle vs full installer).

irene: Also adding a small note for operator docs about DNS sticky entries during cutover — that was the sneaky failure mode last time.

alex: Perfect. Meeting scheduled 2pm tomorrow to close decisions. Thanks everyone. :tada:
